card.name: Small words in bleeding-risk warnings
card.fires_on: Small linking or modifying words (of, and, to, any, planned, active) inside warnings about bleeding, hemorrhage or bruising risk. The word sits just before a surgery, a co-medication or a bleeding-source term.

modes.label: Before surgery or procedures
modes.description: Words such as to, any, planned right before surgical procedures in a hemorrhage warning.
modes.example: hold VONJO prior to any<< planned>> surgical procedures.

modes.label: Before co-medications
modes.description: Of or and after concomitant use, ahead of drugs that raise bleeding risk.
modes.example: Concomitant use<< of>> drugs affecting hemostasis may increase the

modes.label: In lists of bleeding risk factors
modes.description: The word active or a comma in a list of bleeding conditions.
modes.example: congenital or acquired bleeding disorders,<< active>> ulceration and angiodysplastic

card.writes: It pushes toward words about collision, accidental injury and biting or bumping, which fits trauma and bleeding risk.
card.plain: It lights up on small connecting words in bleeding-risk warnings, just before surgery, blood-thinner or ulcer terms.
